run_generate_co3d_dreambooth_data: run the script to generate CO3D DreamBooth images from BLIP prompts using Stable Diffusion
create_load_sd_pipeline: create a Stable Diffusion pipeline loaded from a pretrained model checkpoint on a specified device
create_load_prompts_dict: create a nested dictionary mapping categories and sequences to their associated text prompts
test_load_sd_pipeline: test loading a Stable Diffusion pipeline with FP16 precision and DPM scheduler on CUDA
review_main_generation: review the main generation function that subsamples sequences and prompts to produce DreamBooth training images
